These are retained measurements; artifacts are not revalidated by this generator.
They do not establish compatibility of the current checkout, every build configuration,
or a release archive. Each linked receipt keeps its own input, compiler, build
adjustments and test selection.

The result uses the existing benchmark normalization. PASS covers only the recorded
selection. PROFILE_CLEAN is not an all-program PASS; skips, unavailable oracles,
baseline failures and partial compilation remain visible. Passing/total counts
programs or installed units as labeled, not a common cross-project denominator.
Doom is a separate headless replay, not an addition to the frozen application denominator.

Input version/ref/commit describes the measured project, not EvoCC. Missing provenance is
unknown or not recorded, never filled from today's version or Git HEAD. A recorded checkout is
the recorder's revision, not an inferred compiler-binary source revision. Dates come
